content.comment_body: I purchased a starter kit with [product_name] [version_no] and installed it on a Windows 8 machine. Later, I upgraded to [product_name] [version_no]. Currently, I'm attempting to reinstall it on a Windows 10 system, but I'm unable to get the installation working. What actions should I take?

Hello, I'm not fully experienced with Windows 10, but solutions meant for earlier Windows versions should also work on Windows 10: 1. Run the installation as an administrator (right click and run as admin). 2. Try running it in compatibility mode. 3. Ensure you have the correct update file (32-bit or 64-bit). Alternatively, copy the entire [product_name] DVD to your hard drive, access the 'Windows' directory, select the folder matching your OS type (32/64 bit), and run '[product_name].exe' as administrator. If it launches, try updating through the Internet; the system should automatically choose the proper OS. Hope this helps.

Hello [user_name], Could you indicate where you found confirmation that [product_name] [version_no] is compatible with Windows 10? From my research, it appears that support is only stated for Windows XP, Windows 7, and Windows 8, all in 32- or 64-bit versions. Best regards, [user_name]

Hi, [user_name] is correct. [product_name] isn't officially supported on Windows 10. Still, it's reasonable to attempt installation, since often Windows permits older programs to run. However, if this doesn't work, it's unlikely official support would assist due to the lack of support for this OS. Hope this helps.
Thank you, your advice worked perfectly on my Windows 10 64-bit system. You've helped me save a lot of time. Best regards, [user_name]
